parameters.name: AutoCreateRepo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically create an image repository in the namespace.

parameters.name: DefaultRepoType
parameters.description:
The default type of the repositories that are automatically created in the namespace. Valid values:

*   `PUBLIC`: public repositories
*   `PRIVATE`: private repositories.

parameters.name: NamespaceName
parameters.description: The name of the namespace. The name must be 2 to 120 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and the following delimiters: underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). The name cannot start or end with a delimiter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-namespace --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --namespace-name namespace1 --auto-create-repo true --default-repo-type PUBLIC --default-repo-configuration example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --NamespaceName namespace1 --DefaultRepoType PUBLIC --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --AutoCreateRepo true --DefaultRepoConfiguration 'example-string'
